<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the carbonyl‑ene cyclization described. Using the target molecule SMILES provided, we search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone (C=O) and an alkene (C=C) and form an alcohol and a five‑membered ring, with the appropriate bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol", "ring"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O->C-O", "C=C->C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
